single.sql:
SELECT memory, distance, cycles_per_atomic
FROM atomic
WHERE op = 'add' AND mode = 'latency'
single.transformScript:
# One value per job: the median over the repetitions.
df = df.groupby(['memory', 'distance'], as_index=False)['cycles_per_atomic'].median()
single.layoutScript:
# a2av.cu figure, in the house style of dgx-spark/latency/plot/plotstyle.py.
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

TITLE = "atomicAdd: latency, one dependent chain"
LATENCY_COLORS = {"smem": "#2ca02c", "dsmem": "#1f77b4", "global": "#d62728"}


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (16, 6.5))
    grid = fig.add_gridspec(1, 2, width_ratios=[1, 2.6])
    by_memory = fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 0])
    by_rank = fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 1], sharey=by_memory)
    # one dependent chain, per memory and per dsmem target rank
    names, values = [], []
    for memory in ("smem", "dsmem", "global"):
        part = df[df["memory"] == memory]
        if len(part):
            names.append(memory)
            values.append(part["cycles_per_atomic"].median())
    bars = by_memory.bar(names, values, color=[LATENCY_COLORS[n] for n in names], width=0.6)
    for b, v in zip(bars, values):
        by_memory.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width() / 2, v, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                       fontsize=13)
    by_memory.set_ylabel("cycles per atomic")
    by_memory.set_title("by memory")
    d = df[df["memory"] == "dsmem"].sort_values("distance")
    bars = by_rank.bar(d["distance"], d["cycles_per_atomic"], color=LATENCY_COLORS["dsmem"], width=0.7)
    for b, v in zip(bars, d["cycles_per_atomic"]):
        by_rank.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width() / 2, v, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                     fontsize=11)
    by_rank.set_xticks(d["distance"].tolist())
    by_rank.set_xlabel("target rank (rank 0 does the atomics)")
    by_rank.set_title("dsmem, by target")
    for axis in (by_memory, by_rank):
        axis.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
        axis.grid(False, axis="x")
        axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    fig.suptitle(TITLE)

single.transformScript:

import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

TITLE = "atomicAdd: throughput, 8 blocks x 512 threads, 16 KiB buffer"
# (memory, label, colour): the five places the atomics go.
CURVES = [
    ("smem", "smem (own buffer)", "#2ca02c"),
    ("dsmem-rank0", "dsmem, hotspot rank 0 (SM 0)", "#1f77b4"),
    ("dsmem-rank10", "dsmem, hotspot rank 10 (SM 40)", "#17becf"),
    ("global", "global (L2)", "#d62728"),
]
SCOPES = [("intra", "-", "o"), ("inter", "--", "s")]


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (16, 7.5))
    top = fig.add_subplot()
    # one colour per place, one line style per scope
    xs = sorted(df["contention"].unique())
    for memory, label, color in CURVES:
        for scope, style, marker in SCOPES:
            line = df[(df["memory"] == memory) & (df["scope"] == scope)].sort_values("contention")
            top.plot(line["contention"], line["gatomics_per_s"], color=color, linestyle=style,
                     marker=marker, markersize=5, label=label if scope == "intra" else None)
    top.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    top.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(xs))
    top.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    top.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%d"))
    top.set_yscale("log")
    top.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%g"))
    top.set_xlabel("threads hitting the same word (1 = no collision)")
    top.set_ylabel("G atomics / s")
    top.set_title(TITLE)
    colour_legend = top.legend(loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1), frameon=False,
                               fontsize=12)
    top.add_artist(colour_legend)
    from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
    top.legend([Line2D([], [], color="0.3", linestyle=s, marker=m) for _, s, m in SCOPES],
               ["intra-block: the x threads in one block", "inter-block: over min(x, 8) blocks"],
               loc="lower left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0), frameon=False, fontsize=12)

def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):

def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()

        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))
